a.lede: Millions of sites, services, and devices are at risk of remote code execution thanks to a critical bug in the widely-used Java software. Attackers can trigger the bug by just inputting repeated text
a.title: Critical Java vulnerability puts millions of sites, services, and devices at risk of remote code execution

b.lede: A suspected supply chain attack targeting Optimizely has led to malicious JavaScript being loaded on numerous popular websites, including Zoom, CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce, and GitLab, exposing visitors to scripts designed to steal cryptocurrency and payment information and exploit vulnerabilities in iOS devices. [...]
b.title: Optimizely hack infected CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce sites with malware
